preconditions.description: The length of the binary strings is between 1 and 10^6.
Both strings s and t have the same length n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s) and all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if it is impossible to convert s to t, or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of operations required.

invariants.expression: all(s[i] == t[i] for i in range(n))
invariants.description: The strings s and t are identical if the minimum number of operations is 0.

invariants.expression: all(s[i] == t[i] or s[i] == '0' and t[i] == '1' or s[i] == '1' and t[i] == '0' for i in range(n))
invariants.description: The characters at each position in s and t are either the same or one can be obtained from the other by flipping a single bit.
